description:
Mariana van Zeller and the Trafficked team investigate migrant smugglers, narco queens, and black market steroids in this Trafficked MEGA Episode. Featuring three, full episodes: 

Migrant Smugglers - 00:00 
Mariana heads to Mexico to investigate the billion-dollar business of people smuggling to the US — a system fueled by cartels and corruption.

Cocaine Queens - 44:05 
Mariana investigates a new breed of narco starting to gain power in cocaine trafficking networks of Colombia and Brazil: las jefas, lady bosses. 

Steroids - 01:28:08
Mariana attempts to understand the vanity, insecurity and greed that’s driving the unregulated, billion-dollar black market in body-enhancing drugs.
